response.text:
Here are the deadlines and dates in October. Two are due on 2 October, and the library one has a send-by date of 28 September, so it needs attention first.

**Deadlines**
- Return the overdue library media by Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. The send-by date is Mon 28 Sep 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. You can also extend the loan online if nobody has reserved the items.
- Pay the parking warning fee by Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_w1ny8kz9kmwt]. The amount, "30.00 €", was read from a scan, so please check it against the paper letter. If it isn't paid, a fine proceeding (Bußgeldverfahren) is started.
- Cancel the appointment at the Ausländerbehörde (foreigners' office) if you can't attend by Fri 9 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78]. The letter says to cancel at least three working days beforehand.
- The optional objection (Widerspruch) against the Muster BKK contribution notice is due Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. After that date the notice becomes final.
- Cancel the FunkNetz Smart M mobile contract by Wed 14 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. It must be posted by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- The electricity contract MusterStrom Flex has a special cancellation right because the price goes up on 1 Nov 2026. The cancellation must arrive by Sat 31 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5]. The send-by date is Mon 26 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5].

**Appointments**
- The dental check-up is on Thu 8 Oct 2026 at 09:15 [item:itm_0jf0fq5r5ydx].
- The residence permit extension appointment is on Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. The letter says the permit ends on 30 November 2026 if the extension isn't applied for before it expires. The extension fee is due the same day, Wed 14 Oct 2026, and is 100.00 € [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m]. It must be paid by girocard, because cash isn't possible.

**Payments**
- Fri 9 Oct 2026: additional service charges for 2025, 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n]. The send-by date is Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Mon 5 Oct 2026: rent, 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
